subject: SIG follow-up: network segmentation screenshots & evidence TTL plan
messages:
From: Olivia Park <security@atlashealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Atlas Health SOC2 Team <soc2@atlashealth.com>, SecureAudit <audits@secureaudit.co>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up: network segmentation screenshots & TTL for evidence access

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the SIG responses your team submitted last week. Our compliance team did a quick pass and flagged three small items we need to complete the review:

- Network segmentation evidence: screenshots of the VPC/subnet ACLs showing segmentation controls and the firewall rules applied to the inference tier.
- RBAC runbook excerpt: the steps your on-call uses to add/remove service accounts + link to the KMS access policy.
- Evidence TTL/ephemeral access: confirmation of how long you can grant read-only access to artifact bundles (we prefer 48-72h ephemeral windows).

Can you share these artifacts as Drive links, or let us know if you prefer we download from a temporary share? We also need an index CSV mapping requested SIG controls -> file names so our auditor can sign off.

Appreciate the quick turn here — our audit window is next Tuesday.

Best,
Olivia
Olivia Park
Security Manager, Atlas Health
security@atlashealth.com

[attachment: sig-questions-annotated.pdf (application/pdf)]

Hi Olivia,

Thanks for the clear list. Marcus will capture the segmentation screenshots and Evelyn will pull the RBAC runbook excerpt and KMS policy reference.

Plan:
- I will create a dedicated Drive folder with an evidence index CSV mapping each SIG control to the artifact filename.
- Shares will be read-only and configured with an expiration link. We typically support 72-hour ephemeral shares; if you need 48h we can set that instead.
- We'll include a short redaction note for any PID/PHI that appears in logs or screenshots.

Drive folder (in progress): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3CdEfGhIJkLmNoPqRstUvxYz
Expected delivery: EOD Wed (06/17) for screenshots and runbook excerpt; final indexed manifest by Thu morning (06/18).

-Marcus you can attach the screenshots to your reply.
-Evelyn please paste the runbook excerpt into the RBAC markdown file and include KMS ARNs.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan

Hi all,

Attaching the requested network segmentation screenshots and a short notes file describing each image. Filenames: network-segmentation-2026-06-17.png (3 images bundled), segmentation-notes-2026-06-17.txt.

Notes: the screenshots are taken from our VPC console and the perimeter firewall management UI. Sensitive IPs are masked in two screenshots where internal hostnames appeared; full IPs are available in the runbook if required for the audit (we recommend redaction for external reviews).

Hi Olivia — attaching the final manifest and confirming shares.

Summary of delivery:
- Drive folder (read-only, link expires in 72 hours): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3CdEfGhIJkLmNoPqRstUvxYz
  - evidence-index-2026-06-18.csv (maps SIG control IDs to filenames and short notes)
  - network-segmentation-2026-06-17.png (3 images)
  - rbac-runbook-excerpt-2026-06-16.md (RBAC add/remove steps + KMS ARNs)
  - segmentation-notes-2026-06-17.txt

Access and redaction notes:
- Links are configured for view-only and expire automatically at 2026-06-21T15:03:00-07:00 (72 hours). If you need a different window please tell us and we will reissue.
- Any PHI/PID visible in screenshots has been masked; the runbook excerpt references internal IDs but does not surface user-level PHI. If the auditor requires unredacted logs we request a secured SFTP transfer and an NDA amendment (per our standard evidence transfer policy).

Next steps:
- Please confirm receipt and whether the files meet the checklist. If accepted, can you confirm the SIG control IDs signed off so we can close the ticket on our end?
- If SecureAudit wants an additional screenshot showing packet-filtering rules for east-west traffic we can capture that today.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Manager, Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
